detector.source: read-only pinned tree of the interface branch

instruments.mechanism: PYTHONPATH sitecustomize wrappers over the pinned Interpreter; the driver argv is otherwise unchanged and neither wrapper changes a computed value.

note: Candidates are unverified static evidence, not vulnerabilities; validated_vulnerability is 0 in every report and confirmed_vulnerabilities is 0 by construction. A zero in a component is not a statement that the component is free of findings: read `zero_reason` first. 'no_entry_roots' means the walk had nowhere to start in this component; 'mock_only_entry_roots' means every entry it found sits under a path segment named mock; only 'entry_roots_walked_no_rule_conjunction' attributes the zero to the rules. Raw reports stay outside Git; report_sha256 binds each row to the report it came from.
